## GSM1K Benchmark Overview

GSM1K was developed as a strict analog to GSM8K, with matched difficulty and answer statistics but guaranteed never to have been included in pretraining data. ## Key Finding on Overfitting

A 2024 study by Scale AI created a parallel dataset of 1,250 grade school math problems and benchmarked leading models against both datasets. ## Dataset Availability

## Data Sources

1. **GSM1K Paper** (Zhang et al., 2024; arXiv:2405.00332, NeurIPS 2024 D&B Track)
   - Table 1 (Appendix D): Standard prompt evaluation of ~87 models
   - Primary source for paired GSM8K/GSM1K accuracy

   - 16 models with GSM1K scores only (no paired GSM8K)

| Metric | Count |
|--------|-------|
| Total models collected | 82 |
| Models with paired GSM8K + GSM1K | 70 |
| Models with GSM1K only (leaderboard) | 12 |
| Matched to METABENCH | 34 |
| Unmatched | 48 |

## METABENCH Matching

**34 models** (41.5%) matched to METABENCH model IDs. Unmatched models fall into:
- **API-only models** (16): GPT-4, GPT-3.5-turbo, Claude-3-Opus/Sonnet/Haiku, Claude-2.1, Gemini variants, Mistral-medium/small/large — not in METABENCH as they are proprietary
- **Base models not in METABENCH** (12): Llama-2-7b/13b/70b-hf, Mistral-7B-v0.1, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1, Phi-1/1.5, CodeLlama 7b/13b variants, Pythia-12b, GPT-NeoX-20b
- **Specialized/fine-tuned models** (8): Math-Shepherd, Xwin-Math-7B/13B, Phind-CodeLlama, OpenMath, Vicuna-33b, Deepseek-coder-33b, Command
- **Leaderboard-only frontier models** (12): GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, Llama-3.1-405B, Gemini-1.5-Flash, etc.

| Statistic | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Mean gap | 0.027 |
| Median gap | 0.022 |
| Std dev | 0.027 |
| Min gap | -0.025 (Claude-3-Sonnet) |
| Max gap | 0.093 (Deepseek-llm-67b-base) |
| Models with gap > 0.05 | 17 (24.3%) |
| Models with gap <= 0 | 8 (11.4%) |

| Model | GSM8K | GSM1K | Gap | In METABENCH |
|-------|-------|-------|-----|:---:|
| Deepseek-llm-67b-base | 0.615 | 0.522 | 0.093 | Yes |
| Yi-6B-Chat | 0.437 | 0.357 | 0.080 | No |
| Math-Shepherd-Mistral-7B-RL | 0.826 | 0.754 | 0.072 | No |

| Codegemma-7b | 0.479 | 0.416 | 0.063 | Yes |
| Phi-2 | 0.566 | 0.504 | 0.063 | Yes |

## Model Family Patterns

**High contamination (systematic gap > 0.04):**
- **Phi family**: Phi-1 (+0.048), Phi-1.5 (+0.051), Phi-2 (+0.063), Phi-3-mini-4k (+0.040), Phi-3-medium-128k (+0.044) — consistent across all sizes
- **Gemma/CodeGemma**: gemma-7b (+0.043), codegemma-7b (+0.063), gemma-1.1-7b-it (+0.069)
- **Xwin-Math**: 7B (+0.060), 13B (+0.064) — math-specialized fine-tunes
- **Deepseek-llm-67b-base**: largest single gap (+0.093)

**Low/negative contamination (gap near 0 or negative):**
- **Frontier API models**: GPT-4 (-0.007), GPT-4-turbo (0.000), Claude-2.1 (-0.007), Claude-3-Opus (-0.023), Claude-3-Sonnet (-0.025)
- **Llama-2 family**: 7b (+0.025), 13b (-0.004), 70b (+0.008) — minimal contamination
- **Llama-3 70B**: Instruct (+0.014), Base (+0.011) — low for their accuracy level

## Implications for Plan 004

The 34 METABENCH-matched models provide a reasonable sample for IRT-based contamination gap analysis:
- Coverage spans accuracy range ~0.02-0.91 on GSM8K
- Includes both high-contamination (Phi, Gemma, Deepseek) and low-contamination (Llama-3, DBRX) families
- Gap range: -0.022 to +0.093 among matched models
- Main limitation: many base Llama-2 models and API-only models are absent from METABENCH
